name: kami of transience
mana cost: {1}{G}
types: creature spirit
power toughness: 2/2
static: trample
triggered: whenever you cast an enchantment spell, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
triggered: at the beginning of each end step, if an enchantment was put into your graveyard from the battlefield this turn, you may return CARDNAME from your graveyard to your hand.
